title: Count Different Palindromic Subsequences
constraints: s contains only a, b, c, d

examples.explanation: The distinct palindromes are b, c, bb, cc, bcb, and bccb.

inputFormat: Implement countPalindromicSubsequences(s), where s contains only a, b, c, and d.
outputFormat: The number of distinct non-empty palindromic strings obtainable as subsequences, modulo 1,000,000,007.
